ai.sum: Zelensky announces further personnel changes at the SSU after NABU's Carthage case implicated SSU employees.

items.title: Over 3,000 Ukrainians face detention in Russia's migrant prisons
items.summary: Over 3,000 Ukrainians, including former political prisoners, are reportedly being held in Russian deportation centres, known as migrant prisons.

ai.sum: Reportedly more than 3,000 Ukrainians, including former political prisoners, are held in Russian migrant detention centres.

items.title: Germany exhausts capacity to supply Patriot systems to Ukraine
items.summary: German Defence Minister Boris Pistorius has announced that Berlin has reached its limit in supplying Patriot air defence systems to Ukraine and urged others to step up.

ai.sum: Germany says it has reached its limit in supplying Patriot air defence systems to Ukraine and urged other countries to step up.

items.title: Italy's foreign minister targeted in cyberattack due to Ukraine stance, minister says
items.summary: Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni expressed her full solidarity with Tajani and linked the attack to pro-Russian hackers, Italian media LaPresse reported on Nov. 7.

ai.sum: Italian Foreign Minister Tajani was targeted in a cyberattack that Italian media link to pro-Russian hackers over his Ukraine stance, and PM Meloni expressed solidarity.

items.title: Zelensky approves draft law to reinstate asset declarations for all SSU employees
items.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky has approved a draft law to reinstate mandatory asset declarations for all employees of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU).

ai.sum: Zelensky approves a draft law reinstating mandatory asset declarations for all SSU employees.

items.title: Russian attack causes power outage in Khmelnytskyi region
items.summary: A power outage has occurred in the Kamianets-Podilskyi district of the Khmelnytskyi region as a result of a Russian attack.

ai.sum: A Russian attack caused a power outage in the Kamianets-Podilskyi district of Ukraine's Khmelnytskyi region.

items.title: В центре Кракова открыли стрельбу. Есть погибшие и раненые
items.summary: На Главной рыночной площади Кракова произошла стрельба. Есть погибшие и раненые, сообщает RMF24 со ссылкой на экстренные службы Польши. Информацию также подтвердили на официальном сайте города. Премьер-министр Польши Дональд Туск назвал произошедшее терактом. UPD: Пять человек погибли при стрельбе в Кракове, сообщили в полиции. Преступник был ранен при задержании, его доставляют в больницу. RMF24 и власти города пишут о 10 раненых. 🔵 Нападение. Вскоре после 15:00 из…

ai.sum: Shooting in Kraków's Main Market Square killed five and wounded ten; Prime Minister Donald Tusk called it a terrorist attack, and the attacker was wounded and detained.

items.title: «Трудно считать себя товарищем Сталиным, если ты в течение трех лет берешь Малую Токмачку»
items.summary: YouTube Республиканцы потерпели сокрушительное поражение на промежуточных выборах в США. Демократы получили большинство в обеих палатах Конгресса — Сенате и Палате представителей. Во многом эти результаты стали реакцией американских избирателей на политику Дональда Трампа. Почему за американскими выборами следит весь мир? Насколько серьезным ударом по Трампу стало поражение его партии? И как результаты голосования могут изменить мировую политику в самое ближайшее время? Тем…

ai.sum: Republicans suffered a heavy defeat in US midterm elections, with Democrats winning majorities in both chambers of Congress.

items.title: Secretary of Ukraine's National Security and Defense Council: 'Carthage' case figures never contacted or pressured me
items.summary: Secretary of the National Security and Defense Council (NSDC) of Ukraine Ihor Klymenko said he was extremely surprised to see his surname appear in recordings released by the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) related to Operation Carthage, and assured that no one from the criminal organization had contacted him and that he did not know who had sought to influence him.

ai.sum: Ukrainian NSDC Secretary Ihor Klymenko denied any contact or pressure from figures in the NABU-released 'Operation Carthage' recordings.

items.title: Zelenskyy reports four Russian missile strikes on Kyiv's Pivnichnyi Bridge
items.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy has stated that four Russian ballistic missiles struck the Pivnichnyi Bridge in Kyiv overnight on 6-7 November.

ai.sum: Zelenskyy reports four Russian ballistic missiles hit Kyiv's Pivnichnyi Bridge overnight on 6-7 November.

items.title: Zelenskyy claims North Korean missiles used in overnight Russian strikes targeting Kyiv
items.summary: Ukrainian president declares continued shortage of Patriot missiles, claims Russia seeks to pressure Kyiv and, its partners’ positions ahead of peace talks through strikes

ai.sum: Zelenskyy says North Korean missiles were used in overnight Russian strikes on Kyiv and that Patriot missile shortages persist.

items.title: European troops set to train in Poland for postwar Ukraine deployment
items.summary: Britain and France will lead 2,800 troops from 11 nations in a two-week exercise testing how to move, protect and supply a force to rebuild Ukraine’s military after the war ends.

ai.sum: Britain and France will lead a two-week exercise in Poland with 2,800 troops from 11 nations to prepare a postwar deployment to rebuild Ukraine's military.

items.title: HACC remands SBU General Serhiy Duka in custody for 60 days with UAH 65 mln bail
items.summary: The High Anti-Corruption Court (HACC) has ordered a preventive measure against Security Service of Ukraine Major General Serhiy Duka, former first deputy head of the Department for the Protection of National Statehood, in the form of detention for 60 days, with bail set at UAH 65 million as an alternative, despite a motion by a prosecutor from the Specialized Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office (SAPO) requesting bail of UAH 100 million, the court's press service said Friday…

ai.sum: Ukrainian anti-corruption court ordered 60-day detention of SBU Major General Serhiy Duka, with UAH 65 million bail as an alternative.

items.title: Russia used North Korean KN-23 missiles in overnight strike – Zelenskyy
items.summary: Russia used, according to preliminary data, KN-23 ballistic missiles manufactured and supplied by North Korea in its attack on Ukraine's energy infrastructure last night, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said following a conference call on the consequences of the Russian strike.

ai.sum: Zelenskyy says Russia used North Korean-made KN-23 ballistic missiles in an overnight strike on Ukraine's energy infrastructure.

items.title: Russian forces attack Odesa, damaging residential house
items.summary: Russian forces attacked Odesa in the afternoon of November 7, damaging a residential house.

ai.sum: Russian forces attacked Odesa on November 7, damaging a residential house.

items.title: Ukraine intelligence identifies 6 Russian pilots behind Komyshuvakha school strike that killed 55
items.summary: The Main Intelligence Directorate (MID) of the Ukrainian Defense Ministry has identified six Russian servicemen involved in the airstrike on the Dzherelo Komyshuvakha Gymnasium in Zaporizhia region on November 2, which killed at least 55 people, while more than 50 others remain missing, the press service of the Ukrainian Defense Ministry's Main Intelligence Directorate reported.

ai.sum: Ukrainian intelligence identifies six Russian pilots behind the November 2 airstrike on a Zaporizhia school that killed at least 55.

items.title: Russia deploys own Rassvet satellite network for military comms over Ukraine – media
items.summary: Russia is already using its new Rassvet satellite network for military communications over Ukraine, Reuters has reported, referring to Ukrainian military intelligence of Ukraine's Defense Ministry.

ai.sum: Russia is using its new Rassvet satellite network for military communications over Ukraine, according to Ukrainian military intelligence.

items.title: Russia thrice hits Naftogaz facility in Central Ukraine, sparks fire
items.summary: Equipment was damaged, an explosion occurred, and a large-scale fire broke out as a result of three overnight attacks by Russian forces on an oil and gas facility belonging to the Naftogaz of Ukraine Group in central Ukraine, the company's press service reported.

ai.sum: Three overnight Russian attacks hit a Naftogaz oil and gas facility in central Ukraine, causing damage, an explosion and a large fire.

items.title: Italy foreign minister says he has been targeted by pro-Russian hackers over Ukraine backing
items.summary: The Italian foreign minister said hackers were seeking more information about him and his family, and linked the leak to Rome’s support for Ukraine.

ai.sum: Italy's foreign minister says pro-Russian hackers targeted him and his family over Rome's support for Ukraine.

items.title: Взломавшие Росстат хакеры заявили, что на войне в Украине со стороны России погибли 400-450 тысяч человек
items.summary: «Киберпартизаны» и Silent Crow, ранее заявившие о взломе Росстата, опубликовали оценки числа погибших на российской стороне войны против Украины, основываясь на полученных данных. Первая группа насчитала 393 881 человека, вторая — 450 100. Подлинность и полноту базы, а также корректность подсчетов независимо проверить пока невозможно. 🔵 Версия «Киберпартизан». Группа сообщила , что изучила записи за период с 2022 года по 27 августа 2026-го. В выборку включили смерти с…

ai.sum: Hacker groups that breached Rosstat claim 394,000 to 450,000 Russian military deaths in the war against Ukraine, unverified.

items.title: Private house damaged in Russian attack on Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district
items.summary: A private house was damaged in a Russian attack in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district.

ai.sum: A private house was damaged in a Russian attack in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district.

items.title: Russian UAV hits house in Kyiv amid large warehouse fire in Obolonskyi district
items.summary: A Russian UAV hit a house in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district, while a large warehouse fire broke out in the Obolonskyi district on 7 November.

ai.sum: A Russian drone hit a house in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district as a large warehouse fire broke out in Obolonskyi.

items.title: Europeans have no place at Ukraine negotiating table — Russian MFA
items.summary: The Coalition of the Willing’s plans to launch military drills on the eve of talks on Ukraine confirms it, Maria Zakharova said

ai.sum: Russian MFA spokesperson Zakharova said Europeans have no place at Ukraine talks, citing Coalition of the Willing drill plans.

items.title: Russia may have used North Korean KN-23 missiles to strike Ukrainian energy facility – Zelensky
items.summary: Russia likely used North Korean-made KN-23 missiles in its November 7 overnight attack on one of Ukraine's key energy facilities, according to preliminary findings.

ai.sum: Zelensky said Russia likely used North Korean-made KN-23 missiles in its November 7 attack on a Ukrainian energy facility.

items.title: New U.S. lawmakers, Democrats pledging continued Ukraine support – Zelenskyy
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he expects continued support for Ukraine from the United States, as, according to him, new members of Congress and representatives of the Democratic Party assured him that they remain on Ukraine's side and do not intend to balance between Kyiv and Moscow.

ai.sum: Zelenskyy said new US lawmakers and Democrats assured him of continued support for Ukraine and no balancing between Kyiv and Moscow.

items.title: Italy's Meloni blames pro-Russian hackers for cyberattack on minister
items.summary: Antonio Tajani has said hackers published personal data stolen from him as Giorgia Meloni blamed pro-Russia criminals for the incident. The news follows a string of bomb threats that have grounded flights across the EU.

ai.sum: Italian Prime Minister Meloni blamed pro-Russian hackers for publishing stolen personal data of minister Antonio Tajani.

items.title: Ukrainian forces destroy 2 Iskander launchers, Pantsir air defense in Bryansk – General Staff
items.summary: Ukrainian Defense Forces units struck two launchers of the Iskander operational-tactical missile system, a Pantsir-S1 surface-to-air missile and gun system, logistics and supply depots, and a site where Russian occupation forces had concentrated UAV operators on Friday and overnight into Saturday.

ai.sum: Ukrainian forces struck two Iskander launchers, a Pantsir-S1 system, depots and a UAV operator site in Bryansk.

items.title: Ukraine's Defence Intelligence identifies Russians involved in airstrike on Komyshuvakha school
items.summary: Defence Intelligence of Ukraine has identified a Russian colonel and six pilots responsible for the airstrike on a school in Zaporizhzhia Oblast on 2 November.

ai.sum: Ukraine's Defence Intelligence identified a Russian colonel and six pilots allegedly responsible for the 2 November school airstrike.

items.title: Death toll in Russian airstrike on Komyshuvakha rises to 55 – emergency service
items.summary: The death toll from a Russian airstrike on the settlement of Komyshuvakha in Zaporizhia district, Zaporizhia region, carried out on November 2, has risen to 55, the State Emergency Service of Ukraine reported Saturday morning.

ai.sum: The death toll from the 2 November Russian airstrike on Komyshuvakha rose to 55, per Ukraine's emergency service.

items.title: Zelenskyy reports four out of 36 missiles shot down overnight and Russian use of North Korean weapons
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that Russia deployed 36 ballistic missiles, including North Korean KN-23s, to target energy facilities overnight.

ai.sum: Zelenskyy said four of 36 ballistic missiles were shot down in an overnight Russian attack on energy facilities, including North Korean KN-23s.

items.title: ‘They started bombing us with drones’: Russian attacks unnerve Zaporizhzhia
items.summary: A region once offering refuge becomes increasingly dangerous, as 50 people are killed in a single attack.

ai.sum: Russian drone attacks in Zaporizhzhia have made the region increasingly dangerous, with 50 people killed in one attack.

items.title: Explosions reported in Kiev
items.summary: Air raid alerts are currently in effect in the capital

ai.sum: Explosions are reported in Kyiv while air raid alerts are in effect in the capital.

items.title: Ukraine's energy facilities hit 18 times in past 24 hours – energy minister
items.summary: First Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Energy Denys Shmyhal told German Federal Minister for Economic Affairs and Energy Katherina Reiche that Ukraine's energy facilities had been hit 18 times over the past 24 hours.

ai.sum: Ukraine's energy minister told Germany's economy minister that Ukrainian energy facilities were hit 18 times in 24 hours.

items.title: Sumy shelling kills 1, injures 13 civilians in 24 hours – police
items.summary: One person was killed and 13 civilians were injured or sought medical attention following enemy attacks on 19 settlements in Sumy region over the past 24 hours, the National Police of Ukraine reported Saturday morning.

ai.sum: Shelling in Ukraine's Sumy region killed one civilian and injured 13 others over 24 hours, police reported.

items.title: Heavy machinery arrives at protest against Russian grain transit in Latvia
items.summary: A demonstration demanding a complete halt to the transport of agricultural products from Russia and occupied Ukrainian territories is taking place in Jēkabpils.

ai.sum: A protest in Jēkabpils, Latvia, demands a halt to transport of Russian and occupied-Ukraine agricultural goods through the country.

items.title: Finland considers installing Ukrainian-style anti-tank barriers to strengthen Russian border
items.summary: Finland is studying the possibility of installing anti-tank obstacles modelled on Ukrainian ones to strengthen its border with Russia and NATO's eastern flank.

ai.sum: Finland is studying anti-tank barriers modelled on Ukrainian ones to strengthen its border with Russia.
